messages:
Maya (PM): Quick post-launch check-in. Small backlog of follow-ons: A) crash when cancelling an edit mid-render (reported by 2 customers), B) missing event for feature flag toggles in analytics, C) tooltip copy + spacing polish requested by design. Need to decide bug vs enhancement and which to pull into next sprint. Thoughts?
Jonas (Eng): Crash sounds like a regression. Any stack traces?
Maya (PM): Hector shared crash logs in the ticket — stack shows NPE in client-side render pipeline during abort. Customer impact: session loss but not data corruption.
Priya (Eng): If it's NPE on cancel path, high chance it's a single-line guard. Estimate 1 day to patch + 1 day for release/monitor — treat as P0 bug.
Hector (CS): Customers want fast fix. Two have said they'll throttle usages if not fixed. We should prioritise.
Lina (Design): Tooltip polish is low risk but improves perceived quality. ACs: new copy, 8px spacing, accessible contrast. I can drop mocks that are tiny.
Jonas (Eng): Analytics missing event — backend needs a hook and the client to emit. Estimate 2-3 days; enhancement but important for product metrics. Can be batched with non-urgent work.
Maya (PM): Proposed prioritization: 1) crash fix -> hotfix this sprint (bug), 2) analytics event -> next sprint planned (enhancement), 3) tooltip polish -> backlog grooming, low. Anyone disagree?
Priya (Eng): Agree. Also recommend a short regression test added to CI for the cancel flow before we ship. I can add tests in the patch PR.
Hector (CS): I'll coordinate with the affected customers on a targeted canary and share repro steps.
OpsBot: Deploy checklist reminder: run canary on 10% of traffic, monitor errors for 24h.
Maya (PM): Ok action items: - Jonas/Priya: hotfix patch for cancel NPE (include CI test) - Jonas: open PR and link canary run - Priya: add analytics event ticket with ACs - Lina: upload tooltip mocks and acceptance criteria to RED board.
Lina (Design): Tooltip ACs (short):
```
- Copy: "Edit responses inline"
- Spacing: 8px top/bottom, 12px left/right
- Contrast: AA compliant
- Behavior: visible on hover and focus
```
Jonas (Eng): I'll target the patch for tomorrow EOD. PR will be RED-4010.
Priya (Eng): Analytics ticket is RED-4011 with event name `feature_flag.toggled` and payload shape. I'll attach schema.
Hector (CS): Repro steps and customer IDs added to RED-4009 (crash report). Hector->customers updated.
Maya (PM): Scheduling: Hotfix first, cut patch branch and canary this week. Analytics and tooltip in next sprint. We'll re-evaluate in grooming if analytics slips.
Priya (Eng): If the NPE fix uncovers deeper render lifecycle issues, we might need more time— keeping stakeholders looped.
Maya (PM): Good call. Please raise immediately if scope creeps. Closing here once PRs exist.
Jonas (Eng): PR opened: https://go/repo/pull/12345 (RED-4010). Includes unit test and brief note.
Maya (PM): Thanks 44d. Hector, Lina, please confirm once customers have seen schedule and mocks.
Hector (CS): Confirmed to customers. They appreciate the quick turnaround.
Lina (Design): Mocks uploaded to RED board and linked in RED-4012.
Maya (PM): I'll add these to sprint board and mark the crash fix as hotfix. Follow-up in sprint planning tomorrow.
